terraria.title: Terraria - Free Online 2D Sandbox Adventure Game
terraria.slogan: Explore, Build, Survive in Terraria's 2D World
terraria.description: Dive into Terraria, a thrilling 2D sandbox game blending exploration, building, crafting, and combat. Experience both single-player and multiplayer modes in a world reminiscent of classic 16-bit adventures. Start your journey with basic tools, discover resources, and enhance your stats by crafting specialized items. Terraria offers a unique blend of action and creativity, making it a must-play for fans of adventure games.

HomeIframe.title: Terraria
HomeIframe.description: Embark on an epic 2D sandbox adventure with Terraria. Explore vast worlds, build structures, craft items, and battle enemies in this action-packed game.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Terraria is a 2D sandbox game that combines exploration, building, crafting, and combat in a dynamic and immersive world.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Start with basic tools and follow the NPC tutorial to learn the game mechanics.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Explore the world, gather resources, and craft items to enhance your abilities.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Engage in combat with enemies and build structures to create your own unique world.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Discover vast worlds filled with resources, enemies, and secrets.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Create and customize structures to make the world your own.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Craft tools, weapons, and items to aid in your adventure.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Battle a variety of enemies and bosses to protect your world.
